lectures.title: Alternative: AI Video Generation via Veo 2 & Limitations

cues.en: Creating videos with AI can be
just as useful and maybe even more
useful than creating images with
AI. It's not just Sora though,
because whilst OpenAI's Sora is a
quite capable and modern AI video
generator, there also are other
providers and solutions like
Kling.AI, which is a Chinese
company that have an amazing video
generation AI, which you might wanna give a
try if that's something you're interested in.
And Google, for example, has its
Veo AI video generation
service. Veo 2 is the latest version at the point
of time where I'm recording this, but that of course will also
change in the future. Veo 2 is accessible if
you have a Google Gemini subscription, and you can
choose it from inside the Google Gemini web app,
for example, but also from inside their mobile app,
and then use this tool to create a video.
Now, at the point of time where I'm recording this, it's more
limited than Sora. As you can
tell here at the moment, we can only generate
landscape videos in 720p
resolution, and they're always eight seconds
long. But that, of course, is also likely to change in
the future.
So here I am again trying to generate a video with
help of AI of two dogs racing for a
banana, and let's see what Veo 2 produces
for us.
So here we go, and well, as you can see,
it's not really two dogs.
It's a banana and three dogs
where one of them magically appears all of a
sudden, and that's the thing with AI video
generation. As mentioned, it's not perfect.
It does often contain mistakes like this,
but it's getting there, and for some scenarios, it might
be pretty useful. As with all these AI

different models to find out which one
